summary:
{
  "ledger": [
    "Round table | red surface with a pale central field and concentric coin-like decorations; fills the foreground | same table between the camera and seated man | continuous pullback and orbit change its projected ellipse and tilt without an evidenced layout discontinuity",
    "Four metal cups | staggered cluster in the pale field: nearest cup lower-left, central cup behind and right, rear cup upper-left, fourth cup upper-right | same cluster viewed from the opposite oblique direction, with some cups partially overlapping | projected spacing and overlap change continuously with the orbit; nearer cup bodies conceal portions of farther cups",
    "Tabletop discs and patterned border | surround the cup cluster on the tabletop plane | remain distributed around the central field in the wider view | perspective compresses their spacing as the camera lowers; hands and cups occlude the surface beneath them",
    "Seated man and hands | hands enter from the left side of the close tabletop view; body largely outside the frame | man sits beyond the table, toward screen-right in the final oblique view | widening orbit reveals his torso and chair; hands pass in front of cups, and cup walls conceal portions of fingers and discs lowered inside",
    "Man's chair | initially outside the close framing | dark chair with curved wooden edging behind and beside his torso | revealed as the camera moves around the table; torso correctly obscures the chair back",
    "Background chairs and tables | beyond the far edge of the foreground table | remain deeper in the room, including chairs beneath the windows | lateral parallax and foreground occlusion are compatible with the continuous camera movement",
    "Windows, wall panels and wall decorations | background architecture only partly visible above the close tabletop | tall windows above wooden wall panels, with framed artwork and a wall fixture on intervening wall sections | successive wall sections enter the frame during the orbit; no opening reveals a demonstrably contradictory room connection or exterior background"
  ],
  "findings": []
}
